# Certification profile — variant B (compact surface form)

The supplier holds ISO27001 accreditation covering its hosting estate, and audits the
scope of that accreditation every year.

This fixture exists for the Stage-5 cross-document resolution tests (cross-document-dedup,
stage5-canonical-name-freshness, cross-workspace-isolation): the compact surface form in
the first paragraph is the ONLY certification-shaped token in this document, and the
id-389 tier-1 mock extractor echoes it verbatim as an entity mention. Its sibling fixture
(certification-variant-space.md) carries the spaced form of the same entity; the two files
are deliberately distinct bytes so each staging lands its own source_documents row.
